# Expected join counts for tests/fixtures/scip_harness/corpus (ISSUES.md §5).
#
# calls_matched              correct published call occurrences in the oracle's
#                            strict same-file free-function set (must-match)
# calls_graph_only_referenced correct published call occurrences outside the

# calls_oracle_only          internal oracle call occurrences with no correct
#                            published edge at that exact occurrence
# imports                    IMPORTS edges in the graph
#
# There is no key for wrong published edges: scripts/scip-harness-join.py
# reports them as fabricated and rejects them unconditionally.
calls_matched=5
calls_graph_only_referenced=3

imports=3
